sponsored.t: Relates to fees and expenses in unemployment insurance proceedings; extending effectiveness
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions of law providing for certain fees and expenses in unemployment insurance proceedings to December 31, 2028.

sponsored.t: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions providing for increased supplementary uninsured/underinsured motorist (SUM) insurance coverage
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions providing for increased supplementary uninsured/underinsured motorist (SUM) insurance coverage to June 30, 2029.

sponsored.t: Requires compliance with the city's uniform land use review procedure
sponsored.ls: New York City Health and Hospitals Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Requires compliance with the city's uniform land use review procedure.

sponsored.t: Relates to actions arising out of consumer debt
sponsored.sum: Relates to action arising out of consumer debt; defines consumer debt; replaces consumer credit transaction with such term.

sponsored.t: Prohibits a state or local authority from employing or designating a lobbyist to engage in lobbying
sponsored.sum: Prohibits a state or local authority, or subsidiary thereof, from retaining, contracting, employing, or designating a lobbyist to engage in lobbying; allows for the cancellation of pre-existing contracts.

sponsored.t: Establishes how the MTA shall operate the time-delay egress mechanisms
sponsored.sum: Establishes how the MTA shall operate the time-delay egress mechanisms and when such time-delay egress mechanisms may be used.

sponsored.t: Renames the 157th subway station to the 157th Street  Hispanic Society
sponsored.sum: Renames the 157th subway station to the 157th Street - Hispanic Society located at the 1 line on 157th Street of the New York city subway.

sponsored.t: Broadens the court's discretion to use extended terms of interim probation on consent of the defendant to avoid incarceratory outcomes
sponsored.sum: Broadens the court's discretion to use extended terms of interim probation on consent of the defendant to avoid incarceratory outcomes.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "housing transparency act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "housing transparency act"; requires the division of housing and community renewal to establish and maintain a statewide rental unit compliance registry for covered buildings within the state.

sponsored.t: Includes a statement on the envelopes of ballots for early mail voters, absentee voters and special presidential voters for signature affirmation
sponsored.sum: Includes a statement on the envelopes of ballots for early mail voters, absentee voters and special presidential voters for signature affirmation.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a process for neutral arbitrators to review certain disciplinary decisions and penalties imposed on members of the New York city police department
sponsored.sum: Establishes a process for neutral arbitrators to review certain disciplinary decisions and penalties imposed on members of the New York city police department.

sponsored.t: Implements a students' bill of rights for state university of New York and city university of New York institutions
sponsored.sum: Implements a students' bill of rights for city university of New York institutions to guarantee certain rights to students at such institutions.

sponsored.t: Prohibits early voting on federal holidays
sponsored.sum: Prohibits early voting on federal holidays; adds an additional day to the early voting period.

sponsored.t: Enacts the housing development fund company fairness, preservation, and affordability act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the housing development fund company fairness, preservation, and affordability act to clarify certain provisions relating to the dissolution and reincorporation of housing development fund companies; provides for tax exemptions and abatements for housing development fund companies.

sponsored.t: Excludes violations occurring within a certain distance from a place of worship, funeral home, or similar institution from bus operation-related traffic regulations
sponsored.sum: Excludes violations occurring within one hundred feet from a place of worship, funeral home, or similar institution from bus operation-related traffic regulations as part of participation in a ceremony or religious service.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York civil rights cold case records collection act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the New York civil rights cold case records collection act; directs the state archivist to create a civil rights cold case records collection; creates the civil rights cold case records review board which shall assist the archivist in the collection of civil rights cold case records.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting Eric's ID Law
sponsored.sum: Provides for the placement of a discreet nonapparent disability designation on non-driver identification cards, drivers' licenses and learners' permits; makes technical and conforming changes.

sponsored.t: Enacts the infant vision information, education and wellness program act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the Infant Vision Information, Education and Wellness Act; creates the newborn vision screening advisory committee; provides for newborn and infant vision screening; requires reporting.

sponsored.t: Establishes the savings bank, savings and loan association or credit union municipal deposit program
sponsored.sum: Establishes the savings bank, savings and loan association or credit union municipal deposit program.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain debt arrears from being reported to consumer reporting agencies
sponsored.sum: Prohibits reporting debt arrears of an individual which are due to a COVID-19 related hardship to a consumer reporting agency; provides for the removal of such information from an individual's file with such agency.

sponsored.t: Relates to expungement of records for certain juveniles convicted of a nonviolent offense after seven years
sponsored.sum: Relates to expungement of records for certain juveniles convicted of a nonviolent offense after seven years and satisfactory completion of such person's probation, parole, supervised release and payment of any fines imposed or restitution ordered, whichever is later.

sponsored.t: Relates to mandatory continuing education for teachers relating to mental health issues
sponsored.sum: Requires the development of course materials for mandatory continuing education for teachers relating to mental health issues.

sponsored.t: Establishes a special prosecutor to investigate and prosecute matters involving the death of an unarmed civilian caused by a law enforcement officer
sponsored.sum: Establishes a special prosecutor to investigate and prosecute matters involving the death of an unarmed civilian caused by a law enforcement officer.

sponsored.t: Repeals the Columbia University Education Mixed-Use Development Land Use Improvement and Civic Project Modified General Project Plan adopted by the empire state development corporation on December 18, 2008
sponsored.ls: New York State Urban Development Corporation Act
sponsored.sum: Repeals the Columbia University Education Mixed-Use Development Land Use Improvement and Civic Project Modified General Project Plan adopted by the empire state development corporation on December 18, 2008.

sponsored.t: Relates to the termination of law enforcement officer benefits for malfeasance or serious misconduct
sponsored.sum: Provides that any officer terminated who was dismissed for malfeasance or serious misconduct or resigned or retired during an investigation relating to such malfeasance or serious misconduct shall not be entitled to receive any retirement or other benefit or payment of any kind.

sponsored.t: Requires persistently dangerous schools to file an incident reduction plan detailing the steps the school will take to reduce incidents of violence and disruption
sponsored.sum: Requires persistently dangerous schools to file an incident reduction plan detailing the steps the school will take to reduce incidents of violence and disruption; requires notice to be given to victims of harassment, bullying, or violent offenses of their right to transfer to another public school.

sponsored.t: Establishes the office of ethnic and community media
sponsored.sum: Establishes the office of ethnic and community media; provides duties of the executive director; requires each state agency to seek to direct at least fifty percent of its total spending on advertising to ethnic and community media outlets.

sponsored.t: Authorizes high school students to vote on city-wide education councils
sponsored.sum: Authorizes high school students to vote on city-wide education councils regardless of age.

sponsored.t: Relates to discounted admission and memberships for certain individuals
sponsored.sum: Requires any person, firm, partnership, corporation, or association, or agent or employee thereof, which offers, in the regular course of business, an established senior citizen, student or veteran discount on the price of admission or membership thereto, to offer a discount on the price of admission or membership to disabled individuals.

sponsored.t: Establishes conviction integrity units
sponsored.sum: Establishes conviction integrity units; describes conviction integrity units; creates definitions; provides that a prosecution agency may create a conviction integrity unit to review convictions; provides that a conviction integrity unit may make recommendations for changes in convictions and sentences obtained by the prosecution agency; grants the prosecution agency discretion regarding the conviction integrity unit's recommendations; requires notice to the victim if a petition is filed by the prosecution agency; gives the superior court the discretion to provide relief.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "New York slavery era business and state procurement disclosure act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York slavery era business and state procurement disclosure act"; requires insurers to report insurance policies issued to slaveholders during the slavery era that provided coverage for damage to or death to such slaveholders' slaves; requires contractors seeking to enter into or renew procurement contracts with state agencies to report slavery era financing, investments and profits of slavery.

sponsored.t: Implements a moratorium on digital billboards and directing the commissioner of transportation to conduct a study on the impact of digital billboards on motor vehicle accidents
sponsored.sum: Implements a moratorium on the installation of new digital billboards; directs the commissioner of transportation to conduct a study on the impact of digital billboards on motor vehicle accidents.

sponsored.t: Promotes the inclusion of children living in temporary housing in prekindergarten programs
sponsored.sum: Promotes the inclusion of children living in temporary housing in prekindergarten programs; requires school districts to prioritize homeless children on any pre-K waitlists and provides for the reimbursement to school districts of hiring additional staff to accommodate the enrollment of a homeless child.

sponsored.t: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority and the New York city transit authority to rename the 190th street subway station on the IND Eighth Avenue line to the 190th street Fort Tryon Park station
sponsored.sum: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority and the New York city transit authority to rename the 190th street subway station on the IND Eighth Avenue line to the 190th street - Fort Tryon Park station.

sponsored.t: Provides for the review of policies and practices pertaining to emerging infectious disease outbreaks in correctional facilities
sponsored.sum: Provides for the review of policies and practices pertaining to infectious disease outbreaks in correctional facilities, including the treatment and prevention of the disease among incarcerated individuals and staff.

sponsored.t: Moves the Amistad Commission from the department of state to the state education department
sponsored.sum: Moves the Amistad Commission from the department of state to the state education department.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Jonathan Montalvo to be placed on the eligible list for employment as a university police officer
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Jonathan Montalvo to be placed on the eligible list for employment for the state university of New York police.

sponsored.t: Relates to joining multistate voter list maintenance organizations
sponsored.sum: Permits the state board of elections to join certain multistate voter list maintenance organizations and provide such organizations with certain voter information; requires the state to join a multistate voter list maintenance organization on or before July 31, 2026.

sponsored.t: Relates to hazardous materials emergency response training for incidents involving lithium-ion batteries
sponsored.sum: Clarifies the definition of lithium-ion battery in relation to hazardous materials emergency response training for incidents involving such batteries.
